equal_capital_pos_ev_multis.assumptions: One period; total stake s (fraction of the bankroll at the start of the period) on the card vs s/k on each of the same k legs as singles placed at the same time; leg outcomes independent; model P treated as the true P; each leg win or lose (no voids, dead heats or partial settlement); no rebalancing between legs; indicative same-book prices; log utility. Hypothetical, NOT evidence of live profitability.

note: Cards sharing legs are NOT independent observations; use effective_n, not card counts.
